name: lakeFS
tagline: Git-like version control for data lakes over your existing object storage.
description: Open-source data version control that turns object storage (S3, GCS, Azure Blob, MinIO) into Git-like repositories. Teams branch, commit, merge, and roll back petabyte-scale data lakes for isolated experimentation, reproducible ML pipelines, data-quality gates, and compliance lineage — without copying data. Integrates with Spark, Trino, Databricks, Delta Lake, and Iceberg.
insight: lakeFS acquired DVC (Data Version Control), uniting two leading open-source data-versioning projects under one roof.

modelSupport.notes: Data versioning infrastructure — no LLM involved.

edge: Git-like branch, commit and merge over your existing object storage with zero data copy — versioning the whole data lake, not individual files.
pros: Integrates with Spark, Trino, Iceberg, Delta
cons: Advanced features gated to paid tiers

references.title: Data versioning in Red Hat OpenShift AI with lakeFS
